monument_type: Stūpa or Caitya, Courtyard building, Shrine
description_en: Kāyegu Nani is a large square courtyard surrounded by residential buildings. The Kāyegu Nanī complex comprises of two additionalnanis; Cīdhaṃ Nani and Āgaṃ Nani; and seven smaller courtyards (3 to the south, 1 to the north and 3 to the west). The majority of the residents are from the Jyapu community, although one Amatya and one Muslim family also live here.At the centre of Kāyegu Nani stands a single-roofed south-facing pagoda-style temple housing anaśoka caitya.Above its entrance is a woodentoraṇawith a representation of Garuḍa catching snakes, and below are images of Ṣaḍakṣarī Lokeśvara, Buddha and Prajñāpāramitā. The roof of the temple is made of tiles and is surmounted by a bronze pinnacle and a square parasol.  Avajraand twodharmadhātusmade of stone are located in front of the temple. A bell is supported from a stone beam to the left of the entrance. At the north-eastern corner of the temple is a shrine of Hāratī Ajimā, built in 1995. Behind the temple is a newly made temple housing sculptures of Sarasvatī, Gaṇeśa and Mahākāla. To the west of the temple is a community building (maṅkāḥ chẽ) which, as of 2019, is under construction. To the north of the temple is adharmadhātu jinālaya caityaand a well. A recently built shrine to the east houses statues of Sarasvatī, Gaṇeśa and Bhairava.Inside the Cīdhaṃ Nanī is asanāḥ guthi chẽ/capāḥ,and inside the Āgaṃ Nanī one can find ajinālaya caitya. A south-facing temple of Gaṇeśa can be found inside the Cukacā courtyard. There is a well located between the Musmã and Dhyāka Chẽ courtyards. There is a two-and-a-half storey building called Maṇkaḥ Chen (a communal house for Maṇkaḥ Bhajan Khala) 7 m west of the temple, which is being rebuilt within the RCC system. According to locals, all photographic evidence of the building has been lost, however the stone inscriptions that tell the story of its existence and lifespan are still safe.Cīdaṅ Nani contains a 4-storey building called Capā. This is a communal house for theguthiand for holding feasts. Towards its north is a building which was rebuilt in VS 2047 in the loadbearing system. RCC flat slabs have been used to construct its floor and roof. The top two floors of this building are being rented out, while the lower floors are still used by locals to organise feasts and gatherings. A small alley underneath the house in the south-eastern corner connects it to Cukacā Cuka. Inside the courtyard is a small shrine with an aniconic Gaṇeśa.
description_ne: कायेगु ननि आवासीय घरहरूको बीचमा रहेको एउटा चारकुने चोक हो जुन महापाल नजिकै रहेको छ । कायेगु ननिसँग जोडिएका अरू दुई ननि (चीधं ननि र आगं ननि) छन् र मुख्य चोक भन्दा साना अरू पाँच चोक रहेका छन् । यहाँका वासिन्दाहरू सबै जसो ज्यापु समुदायका छन्, एउटा अमात्य र एउटा मुसल्मान परिवार पनि यस बस्तीमा रहेका छन् ।कायेगु ननिको बीचमा एक छाने पगोडा शैलीको मन्दिर दक्षिण फर्किएर रहेको छ । मन्दिरको ढोकामाथि काठको तोरण छ । तोरणको माथिल्लो भागमा सर्प च्यापेका गरुडको मूर्ति छ भने तल्लो भागमा षडक्षरी लोकेश्वर, बुद्ध र प्रज्ञापारमिताका प्रतिमा रहेका छन् । मन्दिरभित्र एउटा अशोक चैत्य रहेको छ । यो स्पष्टै देखिन्छ कि त्यसै चैत्यको सुरक्षाको लागि बाहिरी मन्दिर केही वर्ष पहिला मात्र बनाइएको हो । मन्दिरको छाना टायलले छाइएको छ र छानामाथि पित्तलको गजुर र छत्र राखिएको छ । मन्दिर अगाडि ढुङ्गाका एउटा अज्र र एउटा  धर्मधातु राखिएका छन् । त्यस्तै ढोकाको बायाँतिर ढुङ्गाको स्तम्भमा एउटा घण्टा झुण्ड्याइएको छ । मन्दिरबाट ईशान कोणमा एउटा देवल छ जसभित्र  हारती अजिमाको प्रतिमा राखिएको छ । यो देवलको २०५२ सालमा पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको थियो । मन्दिरको पछाडिपट्टि एउटा भर्खरै भनेको मन्दिर छ जुन ननीतर्फ फर्किएको छ र जसभित्र सरस्वती, गणेश र महाकालका प्रतिमाहरू रहेका छन् । मन्दिरको पश्चिमपट्टि मङ्काः छेँ (सामुदायिक भवन) बन्दै गरेको अवस्थामा छ । मन्दिरको उत्तरपट्टि एउटा धर्मधातु जिनालय चैत्य र इनार रहेको छ ।चीधं ननीमा सनाः गुथि छेँ अथवा चपाः रहेको छ र आगं ननीमा एउटा जिनालय चैत्य रहेको छ । चुकचा चोकमा गणेशको दक्षिणाभिमुख मन्दिर रहेको छ । मुस्माँ चोक र ध्याक छेँको बीचमा एउटा इनार रहेको छ ।
